title: Classic American BLT Wrap
description: A twist on the classic BLT sandwich, served in a crispy naan wrap.

ingredients.name: Bacon
ingredients.notes: Cook at 350°F (175°C) for 12-15 minutes or until crispy.

instructions: Cook the bacon in the oven for 12-15 minutes or until crispy.
Cut the naan bread into 4 equal pieces.
Assemble the wrap by spreading mayonnaise on each piece of naan bread.
Add lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, onions, and bacon.
Fold the naan bread in half to enclose the filling.
Cut the wrap in half and serve immediately.
